entities.summary: Reinert K. Olsen, known professionally as Ray Kay, is a Norwegian director and photographer who is currently based in Los Angeles. He is a music video and advertising director. Ray Kay was a painters & sculptors from Haugesund hospital (b. 1978-07-10, Haugesund hospital). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
